composition_subtypes.role: prunes n > 60 using bit-length pigeonhole principle
enumerates all (i,j,k) segment splits to find minimal steps

payload.core_composition_summary: Uses bit-length pigeonhole to shortcut when n>60, else brute-force enumerates all possible two-segment splits to find minimal operations.
payload.rationale: The solution combines a bit manipulation heuristic to prune large cases and a complete search over O(n^3) segmentations for small n.
